newsitem.title: USA: CME Pork bellies lock down limit on stops.
newsitem.headline: CME Pork bellies lock down limit on stops.

text.p: Further technical sell stops locked May through August CME pork belly futures down the 3.000 cent per lb daily limit.

Traders cited an overbought condition, especially since futures held such a large premium to cash, and this weighed on prices from shortly after the opening. Continued weakness in hog futures also weighed on sentiment, they said.
May was down limit at 87.200, July was limit down at 89.025 and August was limit down at 87.825 cents. Other months were off 1.825 to 1.300 cents.
